features.feature: Laptop graphics and bounded display resolution
features.observed_initial_state: v1.7 density caps still allowed render work to grow with window area.
features.intended_behavior: Explicit Laptop preset; preserve chosen presets while bounding render pixels on initial load, resize and display-density changes.
features.dependencies: WebGL rendering; display dimensions; existing lower-effect scene paths. Physical laptop speed is not inferred.

features.feature: Plain menu and accessible settings navigation

features.feature: Keyboard fire and optional hold/toggle controls

features.observed_initial_state: Existing pause/blur cleanup; native system sleep was not explicitly bridged to the renderer.

features.feature: Unavailable graphics startup message and retry

features.intended_behavior: Clear failure message and usable Retry when WebGL context creation fails.
features.dependencies: Injected Chrome graphics failure; not certification of an unsupported physical GPU.
